answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism employs a probabilistic voting system, where agents participate in auctions to allocate resources. Each agent generates a unique, time-stamped identifier, akin to a yarrow seed, ensuring distinctness. A gale-like randomization process ensures no two agents can produce identical identifiers, preventing fake identities. The system maintains a mirror-like transparency, where all transactions are publicly recorded, allowing agents to verify the legitimacy of others' participation, thereby deterring Sybil attacks.
